correctness.rationale: For two independent endpoint-uniform chords, unoriented line angle is uniform on [0,pi) and signed offset has arcsine law. The determinant Jacobian from intersection x to two line offsets yields radial-angle joint density 2r sin(t) K_r(t)/pi^3. The known Bortolotto–Souza radial density 4[-ln(1−r²)]/(pi²r) normalizes conditional angular density. For r→0, K_r→pi and L/r²→1, giving (1/2)sin t; as r→1, the two separated reciprocal-square-root singularities each contribute L/sin t, so K_r/L→2/sin t and f_r→1/pi almost everywhere. Scheffé upgrades to total variation because each density integrates to one. Independent quadrature at r=.25,.8,.99 recovered total angular normalization within integration precision. The proof is correct for 0<r<1 and the supplementary angle convention.
